build_IINAgentModule: build a PyTorch module that maintains a 2D semantic map and detects object goals via SuperGlue keypoint correspondences
create_ImageNavAgent: create an agent that navigates to objects specified by images using semantic mapping and frontier-based exploration
run_ImageNavAgent_act: run the ImageNavAgent act method to compute a discrete navigation action from environment observations
review_IINAgentModule_superglue: review the IINAgentModule superglue method that detects and localizes goals using confidence scores or match counts
refactor_ImageNavAgent_prep_goal_map_inp: refactor the ImageNavAgent _prep_goal_map_input method to cluster goal points with DBSCAN and filter noisy projections
